title.en: An Act Creating the Municipality of Sugbongcogon in the Province of Misamis Oriental
title.orig: An Act Creating the Municipality of Sugbongcogon in the Province of Misamis Oriental

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3633_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The barrios of Sugbongcogon, Kaulayanon, Kidampas, Silad, Alicomohan and Mabini are hereby separated from the Municipality of Kinoguitan, Province of Misamis Oriental, and constituted into a new municipality to be known as the Municipality of Sugbongcogon, with the seat of the municipal government at the present side of the barrio of Sugbongcogon.

The first mayor, vice-mayor, and councilors of the said municipality shall be appointed by the President of the Philippines with the consent of the Commission on Appointments and shall continue in office until their successors shall have been elected and shall have qualified in the next general election for local officials.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
